title: Chosen model not applied after /setup
summary: After /setup, the bot may keep calling an older model and fail with a 404.

title: Sandbox is not isolation
summary: The builtin sandbox is a limited subprocess, not a container or VM.
workaround: Run on a host you can afford to lose data on.

title: Shell runs as the bot's user
summary: The guard lists reduce mistakes but are not a boundary.
search_terms: shell runs as the bot's user
workaround: Leave the shell off unless needed.

title: Vault file is plain JSON
summary: Secrets are stored unencrypted in data/secrets_vault.json.

title: No chat way to store a secret
summary: The vault has no chat command to add secrets yet.
search_terms: no chat way to store a secret
workaround: Edit the vault file on the host.

title: Discord approval session is per channel
summary: Allow Session applies to everyone in that channel.
search_terms: discord approval session is per channel

title: Telegram drops pending updates at start
summary: Messages sent while the bot was down are ignored.
search_terms: telegram drops pending updates at start

title: Discord uses prefix commands
summary: The slash command tree is synced but empty.

title: No inbound media
summary: Photos and files sent to the bot are not read.

title: MCP connectors are not wired in
summary: Config-only code exists. The agent loop does not use it.
search_terms: mcp connectors are not wired in

title: Skill Market is not built
summary: The market folder is a placeholder.

title: Sub-agents are notes
summary: No second model runs. Records are lost on restart.

title: DNS rebinding in the page reader
summary: Fixed in PR #22: each hop resolves once and connects to the checked address.
search_terms: dns rebinding in the page reader

title: History shortening is not model-based
summary: Old messages are replaced by a simple text summary.
